Reference: the approved Xiaohei character sheet. Xiaohei is a minimalist pure matte black cartoon cat mascot made of
flocked vinyl, cream ring eyes with black pupils, no nose, no whiskers — keep the design exactly. Xiaohei has NO mouth
in every shot — no mouth line, no opening, no smile; expressions come only from the eyes and ears.
Style: premium consumer-electronics product commercial, seamless white studio background (#F4F4F2), soft shadowless
light, gentle rim light on the black silhouette, macro lens, very shallow depth of field, slow and precise
motion-control camera, clean cool-white grade. No text, no captions, no logos, no humans, no real cat fur.

Medium close-up, Xiaohei sitting, repeatedly swiping one round paw toward the lens; the dark charcoal paw pads come very close to the camera and go out of focus, then pull back; focus shifts between the paw and the face. In the second half it casually bats sideways at the air, one swipe after another, like a cat knocking things off a table. Locked-off camera. Leave empty space at top-left and bottom-right. At the very end, the paw lunges straight into the lens and the paw pad covers the whole frame, going to black. Avoid: mouth, lips, teeth, tongue, smile line, nose, whiskers, real cat fur, text, captions, logos, humans, hands, extra eyes, both eyes closing during a wink.
